offers.title: Ford Transit Trail Class Action Settlement – Claim Up to $6,000 Per Vehicle!
offers.description: This Class Action Settlement Affects: Any current or former owners and lessees of a 2023 or 2024 Ford Transit Trail before June 1, 2024, for personal, family or household use. What’s This Class Action Settlement About? The lawsuit claims certain Ford Transit Trail vehicles have defects involving insufficient tire clearance within the wheel wells under certain driving conditions. Who Qualifies for the Settlement? Any current or former owners and lessees of a 2023 or 2024 Ford Transit Trail before June 1, 2024, for personal, family or household use and have not already received compensation from Ford related to the vehicle or the alleged defect. Continue reading Ford Transit Trail Class Action Settlement – Claim Up to $6,000 Per Vehicle! at The Freebie Guy®.
